Naelcrotix is a death elemental located in the Maw. It spawns as part of the Wrath of the Jailer event.
Nal'tari is an Ur'zul located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. It is summoned through the Wailing Pendant during Torghast: Beasts of Prodigum.
__NOTOC__ Nal'ragas is a dreadlord who impersonated Chelra the Bladewall ever since she was beheaded for helping in Prince Renathal's rebellion.
Nar'thalas Protector's Cape is a quest reward from Nar'thalas Still Suffers.

Naaru Shard Fragment can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 150 Cataloged Research and 75 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.

Name A Better Duo, I'll Wait is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating The Tarragrue after entering the mists and reuniting Moriaz the Red with Buttons in the Sanctum of Domination on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of ten achievements required for the Glory of the Dominant Raider meta-achievement.
Nagaz Parchment was never made available, but likely belonged to Nagaz.
Nar'thalas Pauldrons are a quest reward from Round 1, Fight!.
Nar'thalas Bracers are a quest reward from The Headmistress' Keys.

Nallu is a tuskarr located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.

Nahma is a bakar located in Cloverwood Hollow in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Nalyx is a dracthyr located on the Lost Arvillo in the Waking Shores.

Nal ks'kol is a titan facility in southeastern Zaralek Cavern. Players visit the facility for the duration of the second chapter of the Embers of Neltharion campaign, "Sundered Legacy", starting with Future Aspects. The area is surrounded by the Crystal Fields to the north and northwest, and bordered by the Sundered Flame Camp to the west. The area is occupied by Nal ks'kol Defense Orbs, Redolent Whelks, and the occasional Sundered Defender pushing out from their camp. Outside is a large stone called Binding Oaths, one of the Ancient Stones of Zaralek criteria: ;Binding Oaths :When at last we breached these hidden halls, the master was wroth. :He murmured angry words about Tyr's many secrets
Napps is sold by Thistlefir in the Emerald Dream for 800 Seedbloom.

Nagojut is a tuskarr vendor aboard the Walker of Waves, a giant turtle that swims between Moa'ki Harbor and Unu'pe. He later travels to Iskaara in the Dragon Isles to meet the tuskarr living there.
Nature Resistance Totem is a totem that increases Nature Resistance of all raid members within 30 yards.
Nature's Grasp is a buff that gives melee attackers a 100% chance of being afflicted with Entangling Roots. It is learned at level 10.
Nat Pagle's Guide to Extreme Anglin can be looted from corpses in Alterac Valley.

Nara Wildmane is tauren druid located in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is young with a fierce spirit, and has adventuring experiences, including traveling to the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. She was friends with Mulgris Deepriver. She and Sage Truthseeker were working together on discovering the mysteries of Uldum and its related objects.
Nature Protection Potion is a potion that absorbs a random amount of nature damage.
__NOTOC__ Nat Pagle's Extreme Angler FC-5000 is a fishing pole.
__NOTOC__ Narret Shadowgrove is a night elf trade goods vendor located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ Nartok is an orc warlock trainer located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

Narain Soothfancy is a gnome quest giver and 'master soothsayer' residing at Bootlegger Outpost. He is an old acquaintance of the blue dragon Azuregos, who frankly states that he's a "terrible, terrible psychic but an amazing engineer". Although his home near Steamwheedle Port survived the Cataclysm, he has left that spot and set up shop at Bootlegger Outpost. However, he did not bring O'Reily along. He was critically wounded during the Legion invasion of Tanaris, but an adventurer saved his life.

Narm Faulk is a dwarf quest giver located south of Helm's Bed Lake in the dwarven starting zone of Dun Morogh. He was killed by Dark Iron dwarves while saving his friend Muiredon Battleforge, but was then resurrected by a young paladin using a Symbol of Life.

__NOTOC__ Narm Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He directs shaman adventurers to Kranal Fiss. Following Cairne's death, he was killed by the Grimtotem tribe.
__NOTOC__ Narg the Taskmaster is a rare kobold who wanders just outside the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn Forest. He has a respawn timer of 20–30 minutes.

__NOTOC__ Naraxis is a rare mob venom spider found in a cave southeast of Darkshire in Duskwood. She is red and green, and is the only tamable spider of that color besides the Razzashi Broodwidow, making her a unique hunter pet. She is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.
Natural Alignment Crystal is a trinket for shamans that can increase their spell damage and healing effects but at the expense of increased mana costs.
Nat Pagle's Extreme Anglin' Boots are uncommon cloth boots with a bonus to stamina and fishing.
Nature's Majesty is a druid talent located on tier 2 of the Balance tree.
Narv Hidecrafter is a tauren artisan leatherworking trainer located at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

Nataka Longhorn is a tauren quest giver located at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. His brother is Cliffwatcher Longhorn. In the wake of the Cataclysm, it is revealed that Cliffwatcher Longhorn pledged loyalty to the Grimtotem tribe a long time ago and was acting as their spy. It is unknown if Nataka became aware of his brother's treachery to the Horde.

Part of a lengthy quest chain from Nathanos Blightcaller, this quest provides a Rotten Apple (old) that disguises you as a member of the Scarlet Crusade so that you can go speak with Crusader Lord Valdelmar. Your purpose is to trick him into having the Scarlet Oracle Demetria take to the road so that you can slay her.
Nathanos' Chest was provided as an objective for Nathanos' Ruse.

Nature's Bounty (formerly Improved Regrowth) is a druid talent in the Restoration tree, available after spending 15 talent points in the Restoration tree. It increases the critical effect chance of the healing spell Regrowth and when you have Rejuvenation active on three or more targets, the cast time of Nourish is reduced.
__NOTOC__ Narina is a blood elf bow and gun vendor located at Farstrider Enclave in the Ghostlands.
Nathrezim Mindblade is an epic dagger for DPS casters that drops from Prince Malchezaar in Karazhan.

Naturalist Bite can be found in a cage near the last boss in the Slave Pens. When you open the cage, a champion, enchantress, and soothsayer will appear. Naturalist Bite will help attack his captors if you bring them close enough. He also appears in the Underbog and Steamvault.
Nature's Breath is a quest reward from Dark Vessels (Classic).
This item drops from Avatar of the Martyred in the Auchenai Crypts.
Nature-Stitched Kilt is a quest reward from Burn It Up... For the Horde! and Laying Waste to the Unwanted.
Naturalist's Preserving Cinch is an epic mail belt for restoration shamans.
Narain's Scrying Goggles drops from any trash mobs in the Molten Core. Though it is a quest item, it is not group-loot. Only one player may loot the goggles each time it drops.
Native Bands are a world drop from various level 8-13 mobs throughout Azeroth.
:"Those who live in harmony with the wild are a force to be reckoned with." - Kauno Stonehoof Nature's Guidance is a passive talent that increases the chance to hit with melee attacks and spells.
Nature's Guidance is a Shaman talent in the Restoration tree. It significantly increases the effectiveness of direct heals on targets with Earth Shield.

__NOTOC__ Nat's Landing is the name of Nat Pagle's newly renovated fishing spot in the Dustwallow Bay of Dustwallow Marsh. It features a tent for shelter, a couple of fish racks to hang catches from, some rods and reels below a lantern nailed to a tree, and a small rickety dock from which Nat fishes.
Natural Perfection is a 30 point druid restoration tree talent with 3 ranks.
Natasha Morris is a young child found in Southshore in Old Hillsbrad Foothills. It's unknown what became of her.
Narain's Robe is contained in Narain's Special Kit for use on the quest Decoy!.
Narain's Turban is contained in Narain's Special Kit for use on the quest Decoy!
Naturewarden's Treads are epic leather boots for balance druids.
Naturalist is a talent in the first tier of the druid Restoration tree. It reduces the casting time of the Healing Touch spell and Nourish.

Nature's Focus is a talent in the first tier of the Druid Restoration tree. It reduces the pushback suffered from taking damage while casting nature spells. The only spells with a casting time that are not affected are Rebirth, Starfire, Hurricane, and Starfall. Note that this talent only affects the normal pushback suffered from taking damage while casting a spell, and has no effect on interrupt mechanics such as Kick or Counterspell.
Narf is a goblin quest giver who tries to make a living out of hide from worms from the Vice in the Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Narisa Redgold is a blood elf fruit, bread and drink vendor at the Cantrips & Crows in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was sitting on a window.

Nation of Adoration is an objective of the meta-achievement, Fool For Love. This achievement requires you to complete each of the four applicable quests once, requiring a minimum of 4 Lovely Charm Bracelet.
Nature's Splendor was a talent in the Balance tree, you will need to spend 11 points in Balance to max it.
__NOTOC__ Nascent Fel Orcs are fel orcs found in the Blood Furnace.
Natural Reaction is a talent in the Feral Combat tree, you will need to spend 22 points in Feral Combat to max it.
Nascent Val'kyr can be found in Storm Peaks. They were originally aspirants of Valkyrion that were given the blessing of the Lich King for ascending beyond their aspirant status.
Nass is a skeleton summoned to help you for the quest Kickin' Nass and Takin' Manes at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak. He got a toxic dose of blight, and now he is deaf, blind, and mostly numb.
Nargo Screwbore is a goblin zeppelin master at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Nat's Lucky Fishing Pole is a quest reward from Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme.
Nasam's Talon is located to the northwest of Riplash Strand in the Borean Tundra. It is a very small spit in the shape of a hook. Nothing happens here.
Nature's Blades can be found at the Conservatory of Life in Ulduar.

Nargle Lashcord is a goblin PvP rewards vendor. He can be found in the Underbelly of Dalaran and is usable by both Horde and Alliance. He sells the newest season's gear in exchange for armor tokens and Conquest Points. Buying from him requires having at least a battleground rating of 2200 or a personal and team arena rating of 2200 in the 3v3 or 5v5 brackets.

__NOTOC__ Narasi Snowdawn is a high elf located in the Silver Covenant Pavilion in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. She also appears on the Isle of Thunder. She was present in Icecrown during Death Rising.

Nargut is (along with Rhukah) one of the worg pets of Uda the Beast. During the purge of Dalaran, she stayed with Uda. When Uda was rescued, Nargut was devouring a Silver Covenant Vanquisher. She accompanied Uda to the Isle of Thunder. She later returned to Dalaran above the Broken Isles.
Nausea, Heartburn, Indigestion... (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Professor Putricide without using Regurgitated Ooze on the Abomination in 25-player mode.
Nasmira's Soup Stirrer is a quest reward from Rocket Rescue.
Natalie Tootiblare is a gnome located in the Underbelly in Dalaran.
Nature's Ward is a restoration druid talent that functions similarly to a shaman's Ancestral Awakening, healing the druid if they are attack at a percentage of their health.
Narkrall's Leggings is a quest reward from Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer.
Nathan Lamusga was a Forsaken Battle for Gilneas battlemaster located in Thunder Bluff during the monthly Call to Arms: Battle for Gilneas.
Nato Raintree is a tauren quest giver found in the Spearhead in the Southern Barrens. He tends to Gann Stonespire, who was wounded in a raid on Bael Modan.
Nascent Elementium Spikes can be found in Mo'grosh Stronghold, in the northeast corner of Loch Modan.
Narixxus the Doombringer is a rare eredar in the Blasted Lands. He can be found in the farthest reaches of the Tainted Scar, standing behind an altar.
Narsong Trench can be found northeast of the Anglers Wharf and south of the Incursion and the Turtle Beach in Krasarang Wilds.

The two Narsong Spires can be found off the southern coast of Krasarang Wilds south of the Incursion. The Anglers Wharf is nestled between them, and the Narsong Trench can be found north of the eastern spire.
Nascent Kunchong are kunchong located in the Feeding Pits in the Townlong Steppes.

Nat's Fishing Journal is sold by Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds for . It requires reputation with Nat Pagle to purchase. It begins the quest An Anglers Quest, which provides the book that actually awards the +50 Fishing skill.

Narjon the Gulper is a kraken that can be summoned from the Mysterious Whirlpool at Krasari Falls of Krasarang Wilds.
Narzak provides training for Battle Pets for . He has a pet snake named Shifty. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he tried to get his pets away.

Natale was amongst the five mage students of Magna Scavell. As the others, he also was against Aegwynn becoming the next Guardian. When Scavell died, he got another teacher. Like the other apprentices, he eventually joined the Order of Tirisfal and died at some point fighting demons.

Narrok is a master Pet Tamer located in Nagrand. He is surrounded by his three battle pets: Prince Wart, Stompy, and Dramaticus. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Outland and Taming Azeroth achievements.
Narull is an Australia / New Zealand Diablo III community MVP.
Natli's Fireheart Robe is a world drop from mobs in Pandaria.

Nasra Spothide is a level 86 rare pandaren found in the Valley of the Four Winds. She can be found meditating in a small open building near the bridge from the Jade Forest. Nasra is a pandarian champion.
Naralex's Slippers are a quest reward from The Nightmare Scar (quest).

Nathreza is the homeworld of the demonic nathrezim (also called dreadlords), located in the Twisting Nether. It served as a repository for the Burning Legion's arcana and forbidden knowledge and housed a great archive recording every campaign ever carried out by the Legion. Just before the invasion of Outland, Illidan Stormrage assaulted the world with his Illidari and raided the dreadlords' archives for the Seal of Argus before returning to Outland and using a spell in an attempt to obliterate the world. Narcissa was a Highborne enchantress who was so beloved of her own visage that she crafted a mirror that reflected her face for others.

Nargle Boomslang is Marin Noggenfogger's assistant and can be found resting in a pile of gold at Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Nastasia Flairwatcher is a blood elf located at the Assembly Chamber inside the Magisters' Terrace during the Trial of Style. She is one of the two announcers for the trial.

in the background.]] Nath'raxas Spire is a large Legion citadel located in the northernmost region of Krokuun. You must walk through the Court of the Avenger to get here. Lord Nath'raxas, one of the first demonic eredar, resides here.

Narialeene is an employee for Blizzard Entertainment and serves in the role of Forum Engagement for the European World of Warcraft forums. They were introduced by Aerythlea on August 14, 2017.
Nashal was a vrykul. A statue of him called Nashal the Watcher is situated at Nashal's Watch in Stormheim.
Nasha, the Molten Core was an orc located in Blackrock Foundry. She was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
__NOTOC__ Nath'raxxan Soulweavers are Eredar located in Krokuun.

Natal'hakata is a Zandalari troll located at the Great Seal in Dazar'alor. He is the Voice of the King, deliverer of the royal will, keeper of the grand schedule, and representative toward the citizens wanting an audience with the royalty. He is present for the ascension of Talanji as queen of Zandalar. He later traveled to Orgrimmar. When the Widow's Bite threatened the rule of Talanji and planned to kill Bwonsamdi, Natal'hakata was present in a meeting of the Zanchuli Council. He said that they should assembe a force and sent it to the Necropolis. He was then impatient with Zekhan who also wanted to voice his opinion.
Nate Valenta is a community manager for Blizzard Entertainment.
Nauseated Villagers are humans located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.
Nassleax Bigear is a goblin located at Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.

Natha'vor is a blood troll village in Nazmir. The women of the tribe are cannibals that eat the men and refer to their witch doctors as "corpse mongers". Root-Hexxer Ib'aka uses their sacrifices to feed Bloodlasher Seedlings.
Nasty Weeds are vines located in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Nashal's Spyglass is looted from Glimmering Treasure Chest in Stormheim.
Nathrezim Shade-Walkers drop from Varimathras in Antorus, the Burning Throne.

Narsilla Keensight, codenamed Lancer, is a blood elf rogue that is currently in service to Mathias Shaw and SI:7. After meeting Shaw while working with the Uncrowned, Narsilla came into Mathias' service when he offered her a substantial amount of gold to spy on the Horde. Shaw has remarked that she holds no personal loyalties to either faction, but places great worth on gold such that she is now, in no uncertain terms, one of his agents. Narsilla spied on Lor'themar Theron, gaining access to his musings after some time. Outside of random writings, she uncovered his notable comment that "my dusk lily bends more each day toward the sun." In another instance, her information ultimately led to S

Nav'rae was a Zandalari troll noble whose family was among those punished for their ties to the traitor Yazma, though the Zanchuli Council found the family cleared of any wrongdoing. Unable to properly marry her love Khila due to the stain, she petitioned aid from the crown in being allowed to marry her. Her father Bezime spoke in her defense and implored that if Talanji must punish his family, then only he should be punished. Talanji granted Nav'rae's petition to marry Khila, bring great joy to all three involved. Her father was later captured and sacrificed by the Widow's Bite.

Naxxramas is an introductory level-80 raid dungeon floating above the Dragonblight in Northrend. It is a Scourge necropolis, the seat of the archlich Kel'Thuzad, who used it as a location of torture, suffering, torment, and to all accounts some horrific experiments before his defeat. The original incarnation of the dungeon was regarded as the most difficult pre-Burning Crusade raid, requiring 40 well-equipped, skilled players to complete. In the World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King expansion, Naxxramas was moved to Northrend and retuned as an entry-level raid dungeon for level 80 players. Like all other Wrath raid dungeons, Naxxramas has both 10- and 25-player versions.
Necklace refers to a type of equipment worn in the neck slot. Necklaces are also called amulet, choker, medallion, pendant, and other references.

:"The struggle to free the orcish people from our tainted blood has not been easy." Nazgrel is an orcish commander, and was an advisor to the Horde's former leader, Warchief Thrall.
